 Swimming WA partners with Maxiblock to support sun safety across OWS Series 
 02 November 2026 
 Swimming WA has partnered with Perth-based Australian sunscreen brand Maxiblock to support sun safety across the 2026/27 Open Water Swimming (OWS) Series.
 Maxiblock is an independent, family business, owned and operated by an experienced chemist. Its story began in the 1970s, with its sunscreen products proudly made in Australia.
 The partnership will see Maxiblock sunscreen available at OWS Series events, helping swimmers protect their skin while enjoying some of WA’s best beaches and open water swimming locations.
 Maxiblock’s Essential Everyday SPF 50+ will be available at sunscreen stations throughout the Series. The broad-spectrum sunscreen is suitable for both face and body, is dermatologically tested, quick drying and non-greasy, and provides up to four hours of water resistance.
 Swimmers will also have access to Maxiblock’s Clear Zinc Stick SPF 50+, a pocket-sized mineral sunscreen designed for the areas that can cop the most sun, including the nose, ears, cheeks and back of the neck.
 “We're a family business here in Perth, and chemist-operated, so we know how the sunscreen holds up in the water," said Owner of MaxiBlock Thibaut Mortier .
 "A swim day on a WA beach is a long stretch in the sun, and we're glad to be working with Swimming WA to look after that part."
 Swimming WA Events & Partnerships Manager Ben Roberts said the partnership was a great fit for the OWS Series and its summer events.
 “Sun safety is an important part of enjoying open water swimming, particularly when our swimmers are spending long periods outdoors across the summer months,” Roberts said.
 “Having Maxiblock on board means our swimmers will have easy access to sunscreen at our events, and we’re really pleased to partner with another WA business that understands our swimming community.”
 The 2026/27 OWS Series features eight events across Perth and regional WA, with distances ranging from 500m to 10km.
 With Maxiblock joining the Series as a partner, swimmers can enjoy the water while taking an extra step towards protecting their skin throughout the summer.
